statement: TSMC reported Q2 2026 gross margin of 67.7% (up 9.1 percentage points YoY) with revenue up 36% YoY, and raised full-year 2026 revenue-growth guidance to 'exceeded 40%' (from 'over 30%'), citing highly robust AI-server and high-performance-computing demand (HPC revenue +20% QoQ).
why: Strong, sustained AI compute demand gives TSMC pricing power that lifts margins and supports an upgraded revenue outlook, a read-through to robust downstream AI-GPU demand.

impact.mechanism: Rising foundry gross margin and raised revenue guidance confirm robust, largely price-inelastic AI-compute demand feeding the merchant-GPU chain.

evidence.excerpt: Gross margin: 67.7%, up 9.1 percentage points YoY.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet reporting TSMC's primary earnings release; single publisher.
